outline: 基本熱傳機構，穩態與非穩態熱傳導其包括有內部熱源之系統。內部及外部之強制及自然對流。表面及氣體間之輻射。利用因次方法及邊界層來考量熱傳。
schedule:
1-4:Introduction to Tensor Analysis
5：Mechanisms of Energy Transport
6-9:Shell Energy Balance
10-13:The Equations of Change for Nonisothermal Systems
14-18:Temp. Distributions with More than One Independent Variable

期中與期末考：80％
